scope: Salus Worldwide Solutions Corp. as a non-GEO control for Trump-era DHS procurement mechanics

method.verdict_language: least inconsistent, never most supported and never a probability
method.weighting: source independence, causal proximity, metric fit, and coverage; not row counts
method.control_boundary: Salus is a non-GEO control and is not scored against GEO-specific hypothesis groups
method.generality_gate: one vendor and one principal procurement sequence do not establish a department-wide base rate

P.label: policy-responsive procurement channel
P.description: Policy and mission urgency created demand; Salus supplied an unsolicited concept and antecedent experience; DHS used limited competition, comparative evaluation, OCI review/waiver, and urgency authority. This permits process flaws and unresolved OCI risk.
P.falsification: Contemporaneous records show that mission need, invitee selection, evaluation, waiver, or award depended materially on a political relationship rather than the documented policy, capability, price, and procurement rationales.

A.label: political-access or favor channel
A.description: An unobserved political relationship or favor materially affected Salus ground rules, waiver, evaluation, timing, or selection.
A.falsification: Complete source-selection, contact, ethics, compensation, and decision records show no relationship-linked intervention and document independent mission, capability, competition, price, and legal-review reasons for the material decisions.

assessments.note: Facial limited competition and urgency are expected under P but do not reveal who shaped scope or invitees.
Money stocks measure scale, not selection causation.
Comparative technical and evaluated-price results make an ordinary selection channel plausible but do not test subtler ground-rule influence.
Both rivals predict an OCI appearance and formal response; the waiver proves neither absence nor actuality of conflict.
GAO issued no merits decision and the COFC dispositions do not adjudicate the political-access explanation.
A later same-vendor urgency award shows repeated mechanism use but is not an independent contractor context.
Antecedent experience supplies a capability rationale, subject to the unresolved LLC/Corp. legal bridge.
Downstream reporting opacity is compatible with both rivals.
No verified pre-award political bridge was located; the result does not reach private, sealed, protected, or unidentified channels.

least_inconsistent_reading.salus_public_record: P is less inconsistent than A for the publicly documented Salus award.
least_inconsistent_reading.confidence_boundary: coverage-bounded; not an exoneration, probability, or finding of universal absence
least_inconsistent_reading.reason: The closest records identify policy timing, limited competition, comparative technical and evaluated-price results, antecedent capability, and formal OCI treatment, while the bounded public review identifies no pre-award political bridge.
least_inconsistent_reading.residual_uncertainty: Vendor-originated ground rules, the scope of OCI mitigation, political contacts, and source-selection details remain incompletely observable.

central_questions.general_architecture: Salus proves that this policy-responsive urgency path existed outside GEO, but one vendor and a later same-vendor award do not establish a general Trump-era DHS architecture or base rate.
central_questions.diagnostic_evidence: The four-offer evaluation and bounded no-bridge result lean toward P; the OCI waiver is two-sided and non-diagnostic; later allegations, party denials, threshold holdings, and GAO ADR do not resolve causation.
central_questions.effect_on_finding_12939: No verdict change. Aggregate expansion remains H0 substantially less inconsistent; GEO vendor/facility selection remains unresolved with H0 weakly less inconsistent; no named GEO decision bridge is added or removed.

court_posture_guardrails.gao: Outcome-predictive ADR followed by withdrawal; no merits decision.
court_posture_guardrails.article_iii: Primary dismissal ground and distinct from statutory standing.
court_posture_guardrails.statutory_standing: Alternative dismissal ground and distinct from Article III standing.
court_posture_guardrails.interested_party_and_prejudice: Further alternative disposition; not a general adjudication of every procurement criticism.
court_posture_guardrails.bad_faith_observation: Record-bounded observation while denying judicial notice; not exoneration.

database_actions.reason: The non-GEO control sharpens an existing bounded interpretation but does not pass the novelty or applicability gates for a new database theory or GEO-specific ACH score.

best_next_discriminator: Complete source-selection and procurement-integrity file: signed RFP/amendments, market research, proposal revision history, invitee selection, similarity analysis, OCI investigation/mitigation/waiver, technical and price evaluations, award decision, contact logs, ethics/recusal records, and person-attributed communications. Existing human action 70 already seeks these materials.
